description: Read the tenant's deterministic improvement plan: a readiness meter (weighted percentage across forecast-quality and sourcing milestones) plus a ranked action queue. Each action carries an impact sentence, affected/total counts, and the suggested MCP tool to address it. Covers both the forecast lane (history depth, seasonal curves, demand signals) and the sourcing lane (vendor terms, default suppliers, lead times, price books, alternate suppliers). Computed fresh; persists nothing. Operator (unpinned) credentials only.
name: get_improvement_plan
title: Improvement Plan
